spans.s:
मिल् r. 6th cl. (मिलति or मिलति-ते)
 1. To be connected or united with,
to mix, to associate.
 2. To clash.
 3. To happen.

मील् r. 1st cl. (मीलति)
 1. To wink or twinkle, to close or contract
the eyelids.
 2. To fade, to disappear: with उत् prefixed, to
awake, and figuratively to expand, to bud, to blossom.

मिलन n. (-नं)
 1. Mixing with, being in contact with, associating with,
&c.
 2. Encountering, meeting.
 3. Contact.
 E. मिल् to mix, ल्युट् aff.

मीलन n. (-नं)
 1. Twinkling, blinking, winking.
 2. Closing the eyes.
 3.
The closing of a flower.
 E. मील् to twinkle, &c. aff. ल्युट् ।

मिलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Mixed, united, combined, or connected with,
2. Found, met with, encountered.
 E. मिल् to mix, aff. क्त ।

. Unblown, partly opened, as a
young bud, &c.
 n. (-तं) Indirect allusion or description, (in rhe-
toric.)
 E. मील् to twinkle, aff. क्त ।

मीलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Winking, twinkling, closing, (as the eyes.)
E. मील् to wink, शतृ aff.
